question: Find the mean proportional of 98 and 18.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between any two numbers a and b is given directly by √(a × b).

Mean proportional = √(98 × 18)

Mean proportional = √(49 × 2 × 9 × 2)

Mean proportional = 7 × 3 × 2 = 42

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**
